Hard code constants
July 30, 2020
502045 -Code Quality
8
Issue
with giving a fixed value in codes, for example:
dgrView.PageSize
=
10;
The problem occurs when you should change these values multiple times!!!
Preventive Action
: define constants in the common constant module or in a configure files
Common Defects & Practices
Array Index Start from 0
July 30, 2020
502045 -Code Quality
9
Issue
with below C-Language codes?
int i, a[10];
for (i=
1
; i<=10; i++) a[i] = 0;

The Dangling else Problem
July 30, 2020
502045 -Code Quality
10
Issue
with below C-Language codes?
if (x == 0)
if (y == 0) error();
else {
z = x + y;
f (&z);
}
Common Defects & Practices
Null Pointer Exception
July 30, 2020
502045 -Code Quality
11
Issue
: the developer got Null-Pointer-Exception run-time error, while he/she did not detect that when compiling the codes
pPointer
-
>member = 1;
strReturn
=
objDo
c.SelectNodes
(
strName
);
Cause
: the developer does not check null or think about null object before accessing object's value.
Preventive
: Should check null before accessing object or pointer before using its member
If (
pPointer
!= NULL )
pPointer
->member = 1;
If (
objDoc
!= NULL)
strReturn
=
objDoc.SelectNodes
(
strName
);

public bool
IsValidLogin
(string
userName
, string password)        {
SqlConnection
con = null;
SqlCommand
cmd
= null;
bool result = false;
try {
con = new
SqlConnection
(DB_CONNECTION);
con.Open
();
string
cmdtext
=
string.Format
("SELECT * FROM [Users] WHERE [Account]='{0}' AND 						[Password]='{1}' “,
userName
, password);
cmd
= new
SqlCommand
(
cmdtext
);
cmd.Connection
= con;
cmd.CommandType
=
CommandType.Text
;
result=
cmd.ExecuteReader
().
HasRows
;
cmd.Dispose
();
con.Dispose
();
return result;
}
catch (
SqlException
) {
return false;
}
}

Programming Practices 1
July 30, 2020
502045 -Code Quality
13
Issue
with variables or create objects in Loop?
for (int
i
=0;
i
<dt.Rows.Count-1;
i
++)
{
string
strName
;
strName
=
dt.Rows
[
i
]["Name"].
ToString
();
//do something here
}
Impact to the application performance!!!
Cause: memory is allocated repeatedly.
Common Defects & Practices
Programming Practices 2
July 30, 2020
502045 -Code Quality
14
Code redundant issues
:
Create new Object while we can reuse the object in previous command:
BeanXXX
bean = new
BeanXXX
();
bean =
objectYYY.getBeanXXX
();
Variables are declared in based class but it is not used
Common Defects & Practices
Programming Practices 3
July 30, 2020
502045 -Code Quality
15
Avoid using an object to access a
static
variable or method. Use a class name instead.
Avoid assigning several variables to the same value in a single statement.
fooBar.fChar
=
barFoo.lchar
= 'c'; // AVOID!
Common Defects & Practices
Programming Practices 4
July 30, 2020
502045 -Code Quality
16
Do not use the assignment operator in a place
if (
c++
= d++) { // AVOID!
...
}
should be written as:
if ((
c++
= d++) != 0) {
...
}
Do not use embedded assignments in an attempt to improve run-time performance.
d = (a = b + c) + r;
Common Defects & Practices
Programming Practices 5
July 30, 2020
502045 -Code Quality
17
File operations: file read operations must be restricted to a minimum
Clear content of big structure after use: always clear() the content of Collection/Map objects after use
Be economical when creating new objects
In program language that has no garbage collector (
i.e
C, C++): free allocated memory after use:
{
double* A = malloc(
sizeof
(double)*M*N);
for(int
i
= 0;
i
< M*N;
i
++){
A[
i
] =
i
;
}
}
memory leak: forgot to call
free(A);
common problem in C, C++
Common Defects & Practices
Programming Practices 6
July 30, 2020
502045 -Code Quality
18
Use parentheses liberally in expressions involving mixed operators to avoid operator precedence problems
if (a == b && c == d) // AVOID!
if ((a == b) && (c == d)) // RIGHT
Try to make the structure of your program match the intent [goal], for example:
if (
booleanExpression
) {
return true;
} else {
return false;
}
should instead be written as
return
booleanExpression
;
July 30, 2020
502045 -Code Quality

with giving a fixed value in codes, for example:
dgrView.PageSize
=
10;
The problem occurs when you should change these values multiple times!!!
Preventive Action
: define constants in the common constant module or in a configure files
